title: File:Lights of Java.jpg
author: NASA
description:
This oblique nighttime image, taken by an astronaut aboard the International Space Station, reveals Indonesia's main island chain. With coasts illuminated by city lights, the islands stand out against the darkness of the Indian Ocean. The island of Java is the geographic and economic center of Indonesia. With a population of more than 141 million people, it is the world's most populous island.
Spacecraft nadir point: 2.8° S, 108.2° E
Photo center point: 8.5° S, 112.5° E
Nadir to Photo Center: Southeast
Spacecraft Altitude: 218 nautical miles (404 km)

title: File:ISS-53 New York City, Night Lights.jpg
author: NASA
description: The well-lit metropolitan area of New York City, its five boroughs -- The Bronx, Manhattan, Queens, Brooklyn and Staten Island -- and part of the state of New Jersey are pictured in this photograph taken during a night pass from the International Space Station on Nov. 23, 2017.

title: File:ISS-65 Night lights of South Africa.jpg
author: NASA
description: The night lights of South Africa are blanketed by Earth's atmospheric glow and a starry night sky as the International Space Station orbited 266 miles above.
